visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up of a young woman with pinkish-brown hair wearing a grey V-neck t-shirt, expressing high excitement with wide eyes and a broad smile. She gestures dynamically with her hands toward the camera. Behind her are white shelves stacked with storage containers and various office supplies. The scene is bright and uses animated white radial lines and graphic overlays for visual emphasis. (2) The scene cuts to her holding a small, pink-haired figurine in a navy blue school jacket, which visually mimics her own appearance. She also holds a smartphone showing the digital version of the figurine on the screen. The setting remains the same indoor room with shelves. She uses her hands to compare the physical 3D object and the mobile screen image. (3) The visual transitions to a screen capture of the PicMa app interface on a mobile device. It displays multiple AI-driven photo editing features like Mermaid Transformation and Battle Scene through a grid of thumbnails. The woman appears in a small circular inset at the bottom, reacting to the features with expressive facial movements. The app background is dark purple with colorful thumbnails. (4) The screen capture continues, demonstrating the 3D avatar generation process and the subsequent order selection page. The interface lists size options for physical figurines, specifically 6cm, 8cm, and 10cm, with corresponding prices in NT$. The woman in the inset points at the options, explaining the customization and ordering process to the viewer. (5) The camera returns to a physical view of the woman holding the actual figurine, rotating it to show the intricate craftsmanship, including the hair texture and the painted details on the back. She has a small beige bandage on her left thumb. She brings the figurine to her face and blows a playful kiss, with animated pink heart icons appearing on screen. (6) The final shot shows the figurine standing on a stack of magazines featuring the creator's portrait on the covers. A hand reaches in to adjust the figurine's position. Large yellow text banners display a giveaway announcement and a promotional code. The background shows the same shelf setting, and the overall color tone is warm and vibrant.

The creator uses high-energy visual and auditory cues to highlight the ease of creating a personalized 3D avatar and ordering a physical version of it, concluding with a consumer incentive through a giveaway and discount code.
